xmldoc.short_description: Display scatter points in polar coordinates.

description.p: polarscatter displays marker data using polar angle and radius values.
Table input selects theta and radius data from variables in tbl. Multiple selected variables create multiple scatter objects.

example_item.example_item_description: Create a polar scatter chart from a table.
example_item.example_item_data: t = table([0; pi/4; pi/2], [1; 2; 3], 'VariableNames', {'theta', 'rho'}); h = polarscatter(t, 'theta', 'rho', 'filled');
